welcome.title: Welcome to the Survey of Service Member and Family Needs
welcome.subtitle: Lutheran Care — Greater Darwin
eligibility_text: This adult questionnaire is for people aged 18 years or older who are current or former Australian Defence Force members, or members of their families, with a connection to Greater Darwin.
Military personnel from other countries serving in Greater Darwin and their adult family members are also welcome. Family members may live elsewhere.

child_cta.label: Choose the child or young person questionnaire.

text: Thank you for your interest in the survey.
This questionnaire is intended for adult service members and family members connected with Greater Darwin.

sections.title: Purpose of the Survey
paragraphs: Lutheran Care wants to learn more about the needs of service members and their families and how well those needs are being met.

Lutheran Care is preparing to deliver a Defence family support program in Greater Darwin. Before activities begin, we are listening to service members and families. The consultation is intended to inform how planned family supports are developed and delivered, and to identify where other help may be needed.
The project is funded by the Australian Government Department of Defence through its Family Support Funding Program.

sections.title: Who Is Being Asked to Take the Survey
paragraphs: This adult questionnaire is for current or former ADF members and their family members aged 18 years or older who are connected with Greater Darwin. It also includes military personnel from other countries serving in Greater Darwin and their adult family members.
Family members include spouses, partners, former partners, parents, adult children, other relatives, kin and carers. Taking part is not an application for a service or activity.

sections.title: What Survey Participation Involves
paragraphs: Participation involves completing this web-based survey.

The survey will ask you about different kinds of problems you may have encountered in the past year, what kinds of assistance you may have needed to help you with those problems, and whether you were satisfied with the kinds of support available to you for those problems.
In the last sections, we will ask some background questions and you will have the opportunity to comment on the survey itself or on family issues that the survey did not cover.

sections.title: Personal Information
paragraphs: Please do not enter names, contact details, service numbers or details that identify other people. Do not include classified or operationally sensitive information.

sections.title: Participation Is Entirely Voluntary
paragraphs: Your participation in this survey is voluntary. You may decide not to participate now or at any time. If you feel uncomfortable answering any of the questions, you may skip to the next question. You may stop taking the survey at any time.

sections.title: Whom to Contact
paragraphs: For questions about the consultation, contact Lutheran Care’s Darwin Office.

sections.title: About the Questionnaire
paragraphs: This adult questionnaire is adapted for Greater Darwin from the sample questionnaire in RAND’s A New Approach for Assessing the Needs of Service Members and Their Families (2011).

intro.text: Life inevitably creates changes for service members and their families that can sometimes take the form of problems. Based on focus groups and prior surveys conducted with service members and spouses of service members, RAND developed a list of general categories of problems that may come up:

We’d like to ask you to check off the kinds of problems you experienced. Then we will ask about what you needed to deal with these problems, the ways you tried to solve the problems, and your satisfaction with the kinds of assistance available to you.

For this survey, think about the past year and problems connected with your or your family’s life in Greater Darwin. Family members may live elsewhere. Include problems that have been resolved as well as those that are continuing. They do not have to have been caused by military service. You can skip any question.

routing.scope: Adult instrument only. Existing youth and under-7 routes remain separate.

condition_format.ref: A question answer or a derived field defined below.
condition_format.evaluation: Apply every show_if only after adult consent. Missing relationship or household information stays unknown.

routing.page_references: pages[].questions contains IDs referencing the single definitions in questions. Display Q1–Q22 with their original numbers; never number local helpers as RAND questions.

role_and_referent.Q5_referent: self when self_reporting_member; otherwise other, including spouse/partner and other-family respondents.
role_and_referent.show_L_PARTNER: Q3 is not married_member, civilian_spouse or civilian_partner. In particular, show for unmarried_member.

current_partner_status.yes: Q3 is married_member, civilian_spouse or civilian_partner; otherwise L-PARTNER is married or partnered_unmarried.
current_partner_status.no: L-PARTNER = no when the helper is active.
current_partner_status.unknown: Otherwise, including an active skipped or prefer answer. Q3 = unmarried_member alone does not establish no partner.

marital_status.married: Q3 is married_member or civilian_spouse, or an active L-PARTNER answer is married.
marital_status.unmarried: Q3 is civilian_partner or unmarried_member, or an active L-PARTNER answer is partnered_unmarried or no.
marital_status.unknown: Neither marriage nor nonmarriage is established. A contradiction between Q3 and the helper must not be silently resolved by overwriting either answer.

role_and_referent.focal_person: Self for member choices; otherwise the same service member associated with the respondent's connection. Never collect their name.
role_and_referent.spouse_questions: Q6, Q7, Q13 partner items and Q20 refer to the respondent's own spouse or partner, not another relative's spouse.

demographic_conditions.Q6_unknown_partner: If current partnership is not established, retain the unresolved routing state; do not code an unasked Q6 as no partner or no military service.
demographic_conditions.show_Q7: marital_status = married or unknown. Hide when known unmarried; Q7 remains optional and measures marriage duration only.
demographic_conditions.Q8: Show to all adult respondents; no marriage or parenthood precondition.
demographic_conditions.L-CHILD: Show after Q8 to all adult respondents. It does not alter Q8's financial-dependence definition.
demographic_conditions.Q9: Show only to self-reporting current/former members.
demographic_conditions.show_Q10: Show to non-self-reporting respondents. For self-reporting members, show only if active Q6 includes veteran, permanent, reserves or continuous_full_time_reserve.

Q10_referent.spouse_partner: Self-reporting members eligible for Q10, and Q3 civilian_spouse or civilian_partner.
Q10_referent.other_service_member: Q3 former_bereaved_partner, another_connection, none or skipped.

demographic_conditions.Q10_exclusion: For a self-reporting member, Q6 = never_served excludes Q10. A missing/uncertain Q6 is not evidence that the partner never deployed.
demographic_conditions.Q11: Show with the service_referent variant. Ask current stationing, not last posting. Do not preselect not_stationed for former/deceased members.
demographic_conditions.L-GD: Show after Q11. Optional; no answer creates an automatic exclusion.

Q5.foreign_national_guard: Use other_status and its optional write-in, not an ADF National Guard category.

validation.counts: Non-negative integers; blank is unknown, not zero.
validation.within_row: When both counts are supplied, live_with_me must not exceed number.
validation.no_dependants: Cannot coexist with any positive count. Do not fill blank numeric fields with zero.

dependant_status.yes: At least one valid count in either column is positive.
dependant_status.no: Q8 no_dependants is explicitly checked, or all six Number totals are explicitly zero, with no conflicting positive count.

young_dependant_status.yes: A valid count in either column of a young_dependant_rows row is positive.
young_dependant_status.no: Q8 explicitly says no_dependants, or all four young-age Number totals are explicitly zero, with no conflicting positive count.

problem_conditions.sequence: Show the original applicable Page 5.1–5.9 checklists in source order, not a global cue picker or added per-selected-item story loop.
problem_conditions.Q13_stem: without_partner only when current_partner_status = no; otherwise with_partner. Unknown status does not suppress partner options.
problem_conditions.Q13_options: Hide source options 3 and 6 only when current_partner_status = no.
problem_conditions.show_Q15_partner_employment: For a self-reporting member, hide Q15 option 8 when there is explicitly no current partner OR Q6 establishes that the partner is in permanent military service or continuous full-time Reserve service. Do not require the respondent Q5 to be full-time. Keep the option for a civilian spouse/partner or unresolved partner service status.
problem_conditions.Q15_civilian_hint: Show the option-specific hint to civilian_spouse and civilian_partner respondents, referring to their own employment.
problem_conditions.Q16: Show to all adult respondents; hide source option 4 only when dependant_status = no. Keep option 7 independently available.
problem_conditions.Q17: Show to all adult respondents, including those currently single, because a relationship may have ended during the past year.
problem_conditions.show_Q18: Show unless both young_dependant_status = no and independent_child_status = no. Thus show when either is yes or either remains unknown.
problem_conditions.Q18_age: Retain the source age threshold of 22 or younger; this remains adult report, not child self-report.
problem_conditions.Q20: Hide only when current_partner_status = no. Otherwise available and optional; retain spouse/partner, not another-adult wording.
problem_conditions.Q21: Show after the applicable problem pages to all adult respondents.

problem_answer_states.positive: At least one active option other than none is selected; a selected Other counts even if its write-in is blank.
problem_answer_states.explicit_none: The exclusive none option is selected.
problem_answer_states.skipped: An applicable question has no active selection.
problem_answer_states.inapplicable: The question was not displayed because of an explicit routing condition.
problem_answer_states.hidden_answers: Exclude inactive answers from active reporting and category generation without turning them into explicit negative answers.

Q21_Q22.reported_category_ids: In Q12–Q20 source order, include every category with a positive answer. Append Q21 when its text is substantive.
Q21_Q22.zero_categories: Bypass Q22 and Q23–Q36; continue to original Page 8 Background Information in Part 3. Preserve explicit-none, skipped and inapplicable states separately.
Q21_Q22.one_or_two_categories: Do not display Q22. Carry all reported categories forward and record selection_mode = carried_forward, not an explicit importance ranking.
Q21_Q22.more_than_two_categories: Display Q22 with only reported categories. Allow at most two selections and permit skipping.
Q21_Q22.Q22_skipped: Carry no categories into detailed needs questions; retain all reported problems and record priority_selection_skipped. Never select the first two automatically.
Q21_Q22.Q22_answered: Carry the selected one or two categories forward in original category order; selection_mode = respondent_selected.
Q21_Q22.category_details: For Q12–Q20 display checked substantive option labels and the active Other text beneath each category. For Q21 display its text.
Q21_Q22.selection_unit: Problem category, not an individual problem checkbox.

part2_handoff.selected_problem_ids: Active substantive option IDs from the originating checklist; for Q21 use a stable Q21_text item.
part2_handoff.selected_problem_labels: Exact selected checklist labels; for Q21 use the respondent's text.
part2_handoff.other_text: Active category-specific Other text, or null; do not merge unrelated Other descriptions.

navigation_and_display.hidden_upstream_edits: Recompute routing and exclude now-inactive answers from active export. Do not attach stored answers to a different person, category or need.
navigation_and_display.downstream_additional_comments: Required elsewhere because Q21 and Q22 promise an end-of-survey opportunity.
navigation_and_display.additional_accounts: Any later voluntary account supplement must not replace Q21/Q22 or add required chains.
